payload.full_narrative:
Dawn (06:05:00) at the Misty Mountain Pass—the world is a suffocating shroud of grey and white. You stand perfectly still, your breath hitching in the cold air as you strain your senses against the oppressive fog. The mist clings to your wool cloak, damp and heavy, while the silence of the high peaks presses against your ears. 

Every time you think you catch a glimpse of a silhouette or the rasp of a boot on stone, it vanishes, revealed as nothing more than a trick of the shifting vapor or the moan of the wind through a narrow crevice. The mountain is a wall of secrets this morning, refusing to yield even a hint of what might be lying in wait just a few yards ahead.
